keywords: EF 协议安全团队用 AI 代理审计
summary: EF 发布协议安全团队的博客：用协调的 AI 代理审查协议代码，真正耗时的不是找 bug 而是分辨真假，已公开的成果包括 libp2p gossipsub 可远程触发的 panic（CVE-2026-34219）。EIP-8130 交易类型重新编号和 RPC 扩展合并；EIP-7906 为 TXDIFF 加入按地址视图。ameensol 介绍 Privacy Pools v2 的屏蔽池设计。Solidity v0.8.36 发布，支持 Amsterdam EVM。当晚召开 ACDC #182。

items.title: EIP-8130：重新编号 AA 交易类型并加入 eth_call/eth_estimateGas RPC 扩展
items.title_en: EIP-8130: renumber AA transaction types and add an eth_call/eth_estimateGas RPC extension

items.title: EIP-7906：加入按地址的 TXDIFF 视图和账户变化标志
items.note: （forshtat）合并，为 `TXDIFF` 操作码增加参数 `0x06` 到 `0x0A`，使“某合约是否改变”“是否发出事件”这类问题可以直接回答。
items.title_en: EIP-7906: add per-address TXDIFF views and account change flags
items.note_en: (forshtat), merged, extending the `TXDIFF` opcode with params `0x06` to `0x0A` so per-contract questions such as "did it change?" and "did it emit?" can be answered directly.

items.title: EF 博客：分类才是产品，用 AI 代理审查以太坊协议代码
items.note: （Nikos Baxevanis），EF 推文 22:58。协议安全团队用协调的 AI 代理审查系统软件、密码学代码和合约，找到了真实 bug，已公开的一个是 libp2p gossipsub 中可远程触发的 panic，编号 CVE-2026-34219；令人意外的是大部分工作花在区分真 bug 和看起来像 bug 的结果上。
items.title_en: EF blog: the triage is the product, running AI agents against Ethereum's protocol code
items.note_en: (Nikos Baxevanis), with the EF post at 22:58. The Protocol Security team runs coordinated AI agents against systems software, cryptographic code and contracts and found real bugs; one now public is a remotely triggerable panic in libp2p's gossipsub, CVE-2026-34219. The surprise was how much of the work went into telling real bugs from ones that only looked real.

keywords_en: EF Protocol Security running AI agents
summary_en: The EF published a Protocol Security team post on running coordinated AI agents against protocol code: the real work is not finding bugs but telling real ones from fake, and one public result is a remotely triggerable panic in libp2p gossipsub (CVE-2026-34219). The EIP-8130 transaction type renumbering and RPC extension were merged, and EIP-7906 gained per-address TXDIFF views. ameensol described the shielded pool design of Privacy Pools v2. Solidity v0.8.36 shipped with Amsterdam EVM support. ACDC #182 was held in the evening.
